intro: This unit names four kinds of play and the rooms they need. Soccer uses a pitch. Basketball began in a gym in 1891. Races use a track. Swimming uses a measured pool. Ice hockey uses a rink.

Then the unit looks at turns you can see. A referee's whistle, a starting line, eleven soccer players, and five basketball players all come from written rules. The IHSA, begun in 1900, is Illinois's school-sport room.
bigQuestion: How do places and written rules help children share a game?
